sections.content: You know the future from A2 Unit 19, *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional from B1 Unit 7 and *es posible que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 25. This lesson uses them to predict, to imagine alternatives and to talk about uncertain possibilities.

items.spanish: Es posible que cambie la situación.
items.english: It is possible that the situation will change.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más tiempo, prepararía otra propuesta.
items.english: If I had more time, I would prepare another proposal.

items.spanish: Es posible que la situación cambie, y si hubiera más recursos, mejoraría más rápido.
items.english: It is possible that the situation will change, and if there were more resources, it would improve faster.

sections.content: Two different ideas can look alike: *es posible que cambie* is a real possibility (subjunctive, no *si*), while *si hubiera más recursos* is an imagined condition (imperfect subjunctive after *si*). They share the subjunctive, but not the structure.
